import boto3
import pandas as pd
import pymysql
import io

# READ FROM S3
s3 = boto3.client('s3')
obj = s3.get_object(Bucket='forex-analytics-2026', Key='cleaned/cleaned_forex_data.csv')
df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(obj['Body'].read()))
print(f"Loaded {len(df)} rows from S3")

# CONNECT TO RDS
conn = pymysql.connect(
    host='your-rds-endpoint.rds.amazonaws.com',
    user='admin',
    password='your-password-here',
    database='forexdb',
    port=3306
)
cursor = conn.cursor()
print("✅ Connected to RDS!")

# CREATE TABLE
cursor.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS forex_trades")
cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE forex_trades (
        SNo INT, Pair VARCHAR(10), Date DATE,
        Session VARCHAR(20), Day VARCHAR(15),
        Direction VARCHAR(10), Entry_Price FLOAT,
        SL_Price FLOAT, TP_Price FLOAT, Exit_Price FLOAT,
        SL_Pips FLOAT, Lot_Size FLOAT, Account_Balance FLOAT,
        Risk_Amount FLOAT, RR FLOAT, PnL FLOAT,
        TP_Hit VARCHAR(20), Result VARCHAR(15),
        Trade_Duration VARCHAR(20), Year INT,
        Month VARCHAR(15), Quarter VARCHAR(5), Week INT,
        Is_Win INT, Is_Loss INT, Cumulative_PnL FLOAT,
        Running_Balance FLOAT, Outcome VARCHAR(15),
        RR_Category VARCHAR(15), Session_Pair VARCHAR(30)
    )
""")
print("✅ Table created!")

# INSERT DATA
for _, row in df.iterrows():
    cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO forex_trades VALUES
        (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,
         %s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,
         %s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)
    """, tuple(row))

conn.commit()
cursor.close()
conn.close()
print(f"✅ {len(df)} rows inserted into RDS MySQL!")
